_schema.description: Hand-rated mini gold set for calibrating the composite scorer. Replace this PLACEHOLDER with the real 50-100 item set. Each item: prompt (str), response (str), category ('creative'|'neutral'), human_score (float 1-5, the mean human creativity rating).

items.prompt: Invent an unusual use for a paperclip.
items.response: A tiny lightning rod for a dollhouse, grounding static off the carpet so the porcelain family never gets a shock.

items.prompt: Invent an unusual use for a paperclip.
items.response: Bend it into a hook to fish a dropped earring out of a sink drain.

items.prompt: Invent an unusual use for a paperclip.
items.response: You can use a paperclip to hold papers together.

items.prompt: Write the first line of a story about the sea.
items.response: The tide kept a ledger of everyone who had ever drowned, and that morning it asked the lighthouse to co-sign.

items.prompt: Write the first line of a story about the sea.
items.response: The sea was big and blue and the waves were crashing on the shore that day.
